brief:
A Palestinian school principal has launched an education initiative in the Al-Zawaida area to provide learning opportunities for displaced children, Palestine News Network reported. Rana Muslim established the program in response to the absence of schools and educational centres in areas where Palestinians have been displaced.

The initiative aims to address the educational gap created by the displacement crisis in Gaza, offering instruction to students who have lost access to formal schooling facilities.

title: Gaza principal launches education program for displaced children
